description: iOS Production Readiness — Comprehensive hardening of the native iOS app covering security (certificate pinning, jailbreak detection, biometric auth, cache encryption), UI/UX polish (iPad layouts, scroll-to-top, search history, skeleton views), data layer fixes (retry logic, batch favorites, date parsing), and build/CI improvements (crash reporting, analytics, unit tests, App Store metadata automation).

userStories.title: Implement certificate pinning for Supabase API calls
userStories.description: As a security-conscious user, I need the app to validate server certificates so that my data is protected from man-in-the-middle attacks on compromised networks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a custom URLSessionDelegate that validates Supabase API server certificates
Pin the Supabase domain certificate (or public key) for all API communication
Enforce TLS 1.2+ minimum for all network connections
Add a fallback mechanism that gracefully fails if the certificate changes (show user-friendly error)
Verify pinning works in both Debug and Release configurations
App still compiles and runs correctly in Simulator
userStories.notes: CRITICAL SECURITY: No certificate pinning exists. App is vulnerable to MITM attacks on compromised networks. Must implement before production launch.

userStories.title: Add encrypted file protection to QueryCache disk storage
userStories.description: As a user, I need cached API responses to be encrypted on disk so that my data is protected if the device is compromised.
acceptanceCriteria: Set NSFileProtectionComplete attribute on all cache files written by QueryCache.swift
Add file protection attribute when creating the cache directory
Verify cache files are inaccessible when device is locked
Existing cache operations (read, write, prune) continue to function correctly
Add a cache version marker so old unencrypted caches are purged on upgrade
userStories.notes: HIGH: QueryCache stores API responses (events, restaurants, user data) in the caches directory without encryption. Files are accessible if device is compromised.

userStories.title: Add jailbreak detection with user warning
userStories.description: As a security-conscious user, I need the app to detect compromised devices so that I'm warned about potential security risks to my account.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a JailbreakDetector service that checks common jailbreak indicators (Cydia, /var/mobile/Library, fork() behavior, writable system paths)
Show a non-blocking warning banner on launch if jailbreak is detected
Log jailbreak detection event via AppLogger
Do NOT block app usage (soft warning only, per App Store guidelines)
Detection does not trigger false positives on Simulator
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: No jailbreak detection despite handling sensitive auth data. Keychain may be accessible on compromised devices.

userStories.title: Add biometric authentication (Face ID / Touch ID)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to use Face ID or Touch ID to quickly and securely sign in to the app without entering my password each time.
acceptanceCriteria: Import LocalAuthentication framework
Add biometric auth option in Settings view with enable/disable toggle
Store biometric preference securely in Keychain
On app launch, prompt biometric auth if enabled and session exists
Fall back to email/password if biometric fails or is unavailable
Add NSFaceIDUsageDescription to Info.plist
Handle all LAError cases gracefully (biometryNotAvailable, biometryNotEnrolled, userCancel, etc.)
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Only email/password and Apple Sign-In available. Biometric auth improves both security and UX.

userStories.title: Add network retry utility for all service calls
userStories.description: As a user on a flaky connection, I need API calls to automatically retry on transient failures so I don't see unnecessary error messages.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a generic withRetry<T>(maxAttempts:backoffBase:operation:) async utility function
Implement exponential backoff with jitter (1s, 2s, 4s base delays)
Detect transient errors: NSURLErrorDomain codes, HTTP 5xx responses, timeout errors
Apply retry utility to EventsService, RestaurantsService, AttractionsService, FavoritesService
Respect Task cancellation during retry delays
Log retry attempts via AppLogger.network
userStories.notes: HIGH: All services use simple try/catch without retry. StoreKitService has excellent retry logic that should be generalized.

userStories.title: Load favorites concurrently with async let
userStories.description: As a user, I want my favorites to load faster by fetching events and restaurants simultaneously instead of sequentially.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor FavoritesService.loadFavorites() to use async let for concurrent event and restaurant loading
Both loadEventFavorites() and loadRestaurantFavorites() execute in parallel
Error in one type doesn't block loading of the other
Favorites view still displays correctly with partial results
Loading indicator reflects the combined operation
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: loadEventFavorites() and loadRestaurantFavorites() called sequentially. Using async let would cut load time roughly in half.

userStories.title: Add deep link input validation for IDs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need deep link path parameters to be validated so that malformed URLs don't cause crashes or unexpected behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add UUID format validation for event, restaurant, and attraction IDs in DeepLinkHandler
Reject IDs that don't match UUID pattern (8-4-4-4-12 hex format)
Log invalid deep link attempts via AppLogger
Show user-friendly error or redirect to home for invalid deep links
Existing valid deep links continue to work correctly
userStories.notes: LOW: IDs extracted from deep link paths without length/character validation. Malformed IDs could cause unexpected behavior.

userStories.title: Add iPad adaptive layout with NavigationSplitView
userStories.description: As an iPad user, I want the app to use a sidebar/detail layout on larger screens so I can browse content more efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect horizontal size class using @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass)
Use NavigationSplitView on iPad (regular width) with sidebar + detail columns
Keep existing NavigationStack behavior on iPhone (compact width)
Tab bar items become sidebar items on iPad
Detail views display in the detail column rather than pushing full-screen
Landscape orientation works correctly on both iPad and iPhone
Test on iPad Pro 11" and 13" simulators
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: No iPad-specific layouts. Views optimized for iPhone only. iPad users get a stretched phone UI.

userStories.title: Add scroll-to-top button and tab re-tap behavior
userStories.description: As a user scrolling through long lists of events or restaurants, I want to quickly return to the top without manually scrolling.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a floating scroll-to-top button that appears after scrolling down 500+ points
Button smoothly animates appearance/disappearance
Tapping the current tab in the tab bar scrolls the list to top
Haptic feedback on scroll-to-top action
Button has proper accessibility label ('Scroll to top')
Works on Home, Restaurants, Search, and Favorites tabs
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: Long event and restaurant lists have no quick way to return to top. Standard iOS UX pattern missing.

userStories.title: Add search history and recent searches
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my recent searches so I can quickly repeat previous queries without retyping them.
acceptanceCriteria: Store last 10 search queries in UserDefaults (via safeStorage pattern)
Display recent searches below the search bar when search field is focused and empty
Tapping a recent search populates the search field and triggers search
Add a 'Clear History' button to remove all recent searches
Swipe-to-delete individual recent searches
Recent searches persist across app launches
Works in both SearchView and MapView search
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: No search history or autocomplete. Users must retype searches each time.

userStories.title: Consolidate date parsing into a single utility
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a single authoritative date parser so that date formats are handled consistently across the entire app.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a DateParser utility with a single parse(string:) -> Date? method
Support all formats currently used: ISO 8601 with timezone, ISO 8601 without timezone, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, yyyy-MM-dd
Replace Event.parsedDate manual parsing with DateParser.parse()
Replace Date.fromISO extension with DateParser.parse()
Remove duplicate ISO8601DateFormatter instances from services
Log unrecognized date formats via AppLogger for monitoring
All existing date displays continue to render correctly
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: Multiple inconsistent date parsers (Event.parsedDate tries 4 formats, Date.fromISO tries 2, raw ISO8601DateFormatter in services). Risk of silently dropping dates.

userStories.title: Add full detail skeleton views for Event and Restaurant detail pages
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see placeholder skeletons while detail pages load so the app feels responsive and I know content is coming.
acceptanceCriteria: Create EventDetailSkeleton view matching EventDetailView layout (hero image, title, date, description blocks)
Create RestaurantDetailSkeleton view matching RestaurantDetailView layout
Show skeleton view while detail data is loading
Skeleton uses shimmer animation matching existing card skeletons
Skeleton respects reduceMotion accessibility setting
Transition from skeleton to real content is smooth (no jarring flash)
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: Detail views only show DetailHeroSkeleton but body content loads unstructured. Full skeletons would improve perceived performance.

userStories.title: Add swipe-to-delete with undo toast for favorites
userStories.description: As a user, I want to quickly remove favorites by swiping and have the option to undo the action in case I made a mistake.
acceptanceCriteria: Add swipe-to-delete gesture on favorite items in FavoritesView
Show undo toast for 5 seconds after removing a favorite
Tapping 'Undo' restores the favorite immediately
Favorite is only permanently removed after the undo window expires
Haptic feedback on delete and undo actions
Accessibility: VoiceOver announces delete and undo actions
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: Removing favorites has no undo support. Users can accidentally remove favorites with no recovery.

userStories.title: Add crash reporting with Firebase Crashlytics
userStories.description: As a developer, I need crash reports from production so I can identify and fix issues that users experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Firebase Crashlytics SPM dependency to project.yml
Initialize Crashlytics in DesMoinesInsiderApp.swift
Add GoogleService-Info.plist to Resources (gitignored, injected in CI)
Add dSYM upload step to ios-native-release.yml workflow
Non-fatal errors from AppLogger.error calls forwarded to Crashlytics
User ID set on Crashlytics after authentication (anonymized)
Verify crash reports appear in Firebase Console in Debug builds
userStories.notes: CRITICAL for production: No crash reporting. Production crashes are invisible until users manually report them.

userStories.title: Add lightweight analytics for key user actions
userStories.description: As a product owner, I need visibility into feature adoption and user behavior so I can make data-driven decisions about the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Firebase Analytics or Amplitude SPM dependency
Track key events: app_open, view_event, view_restaurant, search, save_favorite, subscription_view, purchase_start, purchase_complete
Track screen views for major screens (Home, Restaurants, Search, Map, Profile)
Add opt-out toggle in Settings view
Update PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy with analytics data collection
No PII (email, name) sent to analytics - only anonymized user IDs
Verify events appear in analytics dashboard
userStories.notes: CRITICAL for production: No analytics. Zero visibility into user behavior, feature adoption, or conversion funnels.

userStories.title: Add unit tests for core services and CI test lane
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests for core services so that regressions are caught before release.
acceptanceCriteria: Add DesMoinesInsiderTests target to project.yml
Create unit tests for AuthService (sign in, sign out, password validation, rate limiting)
Create unit tests for QueryCache (set, get, expiration, pruning)
Create unit tests for DateParser (all supported formats, edge cases)
Create unit tests for LocationService (caching, distance calculation, error handling)
Add 'make test' target to Makefile
Add xcodebuild test step to ios-native-build.yml CI workflow
Minimum 70% code coverage on tested services
userStories.notes: HIGH: No unit tests. Only UITests exist for screenshot generation. Core business logic is untested.

userStories.title: Automate App Store metadata and screenshot upload
userStories.description: As a developer, I need App Store metadata (description, keywords, screenshots) to be uploaded automatically so releases are consistent and efficient.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ios/fastlane/metadata/en-US/ directory with description.txt, keywords.txt, release_notes.txt
Add 'upload_metadata' lane to Fastfile using fastlane deliver
Add 'upload_screenshots' lane to Fastfile
Integrate metadata upload into ios-native-release.yml as post-upload step
Screenshots from ios-screenshots.yml output are compatible with deliver format
Support URL and privacy policy URL included in metadata
Verify metadata appears correctly in App Store Connect
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: App Store metadata and screenshots managed manually. Should be automated with fastlane deliver for consistent releases.

userStories.title: Add GDPR consent flow for data collection
userStories.description: As a user in the EU, I need to give explicit consent before the app collects my location and personal data, as required by GDPR.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a consent screen during onboarding that explains what data is collected and why
Location, email, and name data collection require explicit opt-in toggles
Store consent state securely (Keychain or encrypted UserDefaults)
Add a 'Privacy & Data' section in Settings to review and change consent
If consent is withdrawn, stop collecting the corresponding data type
Log consent changes via AppLogger for compliance audit trail
Consent screen does not block app usage for non-EU users (detect locale)
userStories.notes: LOW: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares data collection but no explicit consent flow exists. May violate GDPR for EU users.

userStories.title: Add offline mode with graceful degradation
userStories.description: As a user without internet access, I want the app to show cached content and clearly indicate what's available offline so I can still browse saved data.
acceptanceCriteria: Show persistent offline banner when NetworkMonitor.isConnected is false
Disable search, map, and other network-dependent features with clear messaging
Serve cached events, restaurants, and favorites when offline
Show 'Last updated X ago' timestamp on cached content
Pull-to-refresh shows 'No internet connection' toast instead of failing silently
Favorites added while offline are queued and synced when connection returns
Offline state transitions smoothly to online without full reload
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: Offline banner shows but many UI elements still trigger network calls. Search and map don't degrade gracefully.

userStories.title: Add in-app notification management
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage my notification preferences within the app so I can control what alerts I receive without leaving the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Add notification settings section in Profile/Settings view
Show current notification permission status (enabled/disabled/not determined)
Add toggle for event reminders (enabled by default)
Add toggle for weekly digest notifications
If notifications are disabled at OS level, show button to open iOS Settings
In-app notification permission prompt on first event reminder attempt
Show notification badge on Saved tab when new reminders are scheduled
userStories.notes: LOW: Settings has 'Notification Settings' button but no actual notification management within the app.

userStories.title: Add StoreKit transaction error logging and user feedback
userStories.description: As a user with a failed in-app purchase, I need clear feedback about what went wrong so I can resolve the issue or contact support.
acceptanceCriteria: Log failed transaction verification in listenForTransactions() instead of silently dropping
Show user-facing error toast when a background transaction fails verification
Add 'Contact Support' deep link in subscription error states
Log transaction failures to AppLogger.storekit with transaction ID (no user PII)
Failed transactions are tracked for retry on next app launch
Support team can look up transaction by logged ID
userStories.notes: HIGH: listenForTransactions() silently ignores verification errors with try?. Failed transactions are invisible to users and support.

userStories.title: Add entrance animations to card lists
userStories.description: As a user, I want cards to smoothly animate in when they appear so the app feels polished and responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Add staggered fade-in and slide-up animation when cards first appear in lists
Animation delay increases for each card (stagger effect)
Respect reduceMotion accessibility setting (skip animations if enabled)
Animation only plays on initial load, not on scroll-back
Works on Home events feed, Restaurants list, and Search results
No performance degradation on older devices (iPhone SE, iPhone 12)
userStories.notes: LOW: Cards don't have entrance animations. Only skeleton loaders have shimmer. Adding staggered animations would improve polish.

userStories.title: Add progressive image loading with blur-up placeholder
userStories.description: As a user on a slow connection, I want to see a low-quality preview of images while the full version loads so the app feels responsive.
acceptanceCriteria: Enhance CachedAsyncImage to show a small blurred placeholder first
Generate or request thumbnail URLs where available (Supabase image transforms)
Smooth crossfade transition from placeholder to full-resolution image
Works for event hero images, restaurant cards, and attraction images
Memory-efficient: thumbnail evicted from cache once full image loads
Fallback to colored rectangle placeholder if no thumbnail available
userStories.notes: LOW: CachedAsyncImage shows progress spinner during load. Progressive loading with blur-up would be more polished.

userStories.title: Add MetricKit performance monitoring
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automatic performance metrics from production devices so I can identify and fix performance issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Import MetricKit framework and register MXMetricManagerSubscriber
Collect and log key metrics: app launch time, hang rate, memory usage, battery impact
Forward significant metric payloads to backend via Supabase edge function
Add performance dashboard data to admin panel (optional)
No user PII included in metric payloads
Works automatically with no user action required
userStories.notes: LOW: No performance monitoring. MetricKit is built into iOS and free - provides automatic performance insights.
